item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight: Green Man's Chefs (Edited and revised)
item.content:encoded:
Like cybersqyd I think this gets a bit over the top… I like the idea of the weird kitchen with faceless chefs… and then I lose all interest when its a #scary door that is forbidden and the chef kills the agents…

I genuinely suggest you take a different tack here. Simplify the anomaly to being the faceless chefs, making good food anomalously… and then expand that aspect. Don't shift it to scary door and scary paranoia other worlds. Sit and consider the weirdness of an anomalous kitchen that makes normal but excellent food.

I think there's a story there.

item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight: Green Man's Chefs
item.content:encoded: Iunno, I'm not personally really feeling this. The outline feels…almost farcical in nature and I'm generally more a fan of like…deeply emotive SCPs. It feels a little like you're trying to focus on too many characters but also quite like there's not really much being done here: the focus has shifted from this interesting anomaly that cooks food in a weird way to uh, a door that you get warned not to go through and it just…doesn't feel like this is the most interesting thing you could do with this?

item.title: Re: Seeking Greenlight: Green Man's Chefs
item.content:encoded:
[+] Open for crit
– hide block

They are extremely hostile to living things, especially humans except for their human employees.

This feels like a weird outlier in your pitch; like…why are the SCPs chefs cooking for humans when they hate living things and especially humans? It feels to me that this'd be more effective if they like were over friendly or whatever and just really wanted to please with their meals whilst also being alien and not really getting that like…cooking a human kills the human?

and no one has seen the restaurant's kitchen. The restaurant shut down due to sanitary reasons.

This feels a little incongruous to me: generally a restaurant being shut down for sanitary reasons would be like cos the food storage is disgusting or something; and so like…need access to the kitchen to know?

Tests were made with various non edible materials and the resulting dish is reported to be delicious no matter what the ingredients were and how it was prepared.

I'm not really sure that it's worth putting this in the article; it feels…like it might just be quite info-dumpy.

I think on the whole, this feels…like a really interesting idea that just needs you to do something interesting with it? Like I think part of me really just wants a like, investigation log where a foundation agent goes in and orders food and just, experiences gradually weirder and weirder things until they finally break into the kitchen and discover some shocking secret about it before the piece ends, y'know? Or just…some sense of the Foundation doing something with like the capture chefs or the investigation that's interesting and not a vague nod to how it was found or w/e.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight: Green Man's Chefs
item.content:encoded:
A mysterious restaurant named Green Man's Kitchen suddenly appeared in 19XX. The building was then contained by the Foundation.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article
Elevator Pitch:

*Green Man's chefs are green faceless humanoids wearing a chef's attire.
*They are sentient and are capable of speech despite without having a mouth.
*No one knows where the kitchen is.
*They are friendly to humans and would love to talk with them.
*When being asked anything about their kitchen, they'll become agitated and reply with "no".

Central Narrative: In 19XX, a restaurant named Green Man's Kitchen suddenly appeared in Alaska. The customers said that they've never seen the kitchen nor any door leading to it.
The Foundation then secured the restaurant and sent in agents to order food and report back on what they were served. Or at least, what they think they were served.

+ show block
– hide block

An agent was able to find the kitchen. He was wandering around the restaurant and found a hallway. He went in and saw a door. But, as he was about to open the door, the agent experienced extreme paranoia and ran away. The agent said that he felt that there was a voice warning him not to come in. Every step he took closer to the door, the voice became louder.

More agents were sent into the restaurant to find the hallway. No one found it and they returned to the entrance of the restaurant. But, 2 agents weren't present. After a couple of minutes, one of the agents was found. He was shaking in fear. The agent was asked on what happened. He said that he and the other agent found the door. They both went in despite the voice telling them not to come in. What the agent saw was terrifying. The second agent was then stabbed by one of the chefs and the agent managed to run away. Just when the agent was about to say what was the terrifying thing he saw, a chef appeared and ran towards the agent. The chef started to repeatedly stab him while [REDACTED]. More chefs appeared and they became aggressive to the other agents. The chefs chased all of them out of the restaurant. After the team managed to exit the restaurant, a closed sign appeared outside the door. The sign read "CLOSED. We are making adjustments to give you the best service".

Hook/Attention-Grabber: These entities can cook delicious food with unknown ingredients. The kitchen was never seen so it remains a mystery on how these entities make the food.
